notes: Two-head LED emergency light for 120/277 V with a sealed nickel-cadmium battery; the APELH2 version can drive two remote heads and has different input figures on the same sheet, so it is not covered here. Whole-unit input for the APEL: 0.33 W at 120 V and 0.47 W at 277 V, max 0.06 A at 120 V and 0.07 A at 277 V.

gaps: The sheet gives no battery voltage or capacity in words; its 3.6 V DC rating (1.5 W for 1.5 hours) sits in the rated-wattage table and with the heads, so no voltage or capacity is put on the battery.
The feature list gives the heads as 3.6 V, .78 W DC without saying each or total; Cooper's product page lists two heads at .78 W, so 0.78 W per head with two heads is used.
No replacement battery part number is confirmed for the APEL, so none is claimed.
The sheet prints separate input values for the APEL and APELH2; only the APEL values are used, and they are the whole unit's input, not a charger rating.
The sheet is dated 2025-9-5 (TD505038EN) and gives no production years.
No circuit board or driver parts are claimed, because the sheet names none.
No maker-hosted copy of the PDF was found: Cooper's APEL product page has no PDF link.
method: Sure-Lites APEL specification sheet TD505038EN (2025-9-5, two pages) with the Sure-Lites heading and Cooper Lighting Solutions logo and address, read from the copy on SupplyHouse's S3 bucket with tools/research.js pdf; both pages rendered and checked.

Cooper Lighting's APEL product page (cooperlighting.com) opened: lists a sealed nickel cadmium battery, 3.6 V (2) .78 W heads and 0.47 W at 277 V input, agreeing with the sheet; no PDF link or catalogue number.

comps.spec: Sealed, maintenance-free nickel-cadmium battery with polarized terminals; full recharge in 24 hours at most; the sheet gives a 10-year life expectancy
Two long-life LED emergency heads rated 3.6 V, 0.78 W DC, fully adjustable; each head replaces a 5.4 W incandescent lamp

Solid-state voltage-regulated charger for 120/277 VAC; after a power failure it gives a high charge rate and adjusts to the battery's condition; the sheet also lists line-latching, a brownout circuit and a low-voltage disconnect at 80% of rated battery voltage
Test switch that activates the emergency circuit for an operational check; the sheet describes it together with the power indicator light
Power indicator light that shows AC power is on
Housing and all components injection-molded from color-stable, high-impact thermoplastic, snap-fit construction; white or black finish
No lead-acid pack; the battery is sealed nickel-cadmium
